items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: A guy named Howard and somebody else, they came in and dude dropped. We were playing there.

ctx.x: Were you working... These were all union. You were in the union then?

Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. I got caught at... Before we went on the road, it was 1952. A guy named Howard and somebody else, they came in and dude dropped. We were playing there. And the guy said, hey, stop the music. You got a union card? Union card?
